title: Andrej Karpathy Open-Sources AutoResearch
description: Karpathy releases AutoResearch, an AI-driven research system that ran 50 experiments overnight on a single GPU using a 630-line Python script. The system uses autonomous AI agents to conduct ML research automatically, designed to run on small single-GPU setups.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Hacker News: 'The Year the IDE Died' (Steve Yegge and Gene Kim Talk AI Coding)
description: Hacker News discussion about how AI coding tools might replace today's IDE as the primary programming environment. Explores the fundamental shift in development paradigms.
author: Steve Yegge and Gene Kim

title: Simon Willison: 'I vibe coded my dream macOS presentation app'
description: Simon Willison shares his experience using AI coding agents to build a custom macOS presentation application the night before a talk at Social Science FOO Camp. Demonstrates practical application of 'vibe coding' - using LLMs to quickly prototype and build functional applications with minimal manual coding.
author: Simon Willison

title: Simon Willison: 'Writing about Agentic Engineering Patterns'
description: Simon Willison launches a new project to collect and document 'Agentic Engineering Patterns' - coding practices and patterns for getting the best results from AI coding agent development. Represents a systematic approach to the emerging field of agentic AI engineering.
author: Simon Willison

title: Hacker News: 'My LLM coding workflow going into 2026'
description: Hacker News discussion on personal LLM coding workflows, with community questioning whether AI provides real speedups. Includes debate on whether there's even a speedup over doing it yourself.
author: Hacker News Community

title: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's GTC 2026 Keynote: The Age of AI
description: Jensen Huang delivers keynote at GTC 2026 (March 16) covering NVIDIA's full AI stack, including accelerated computing and AI developments. The conference features sessions on agentic AI, generative AI, and related technologies.
author: Jensen Huang / NVIDIA

title: Hacker News: 'Ask HN: Best option for hosted agent in 2026?'
description: Hacker News discussion hosted in March 2026 about hosted agent solutions, including mentions of OpenClaw agents and Claude Agent SDK integrations. Community discussion on practical deployment options for AI coding agents.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Hacker News: 'Ask HN: What developer tool do you wish existed in 2026?'
description: Hacker News discussion featuring ideas including 'An LLM tool that can sit on a CI pipeline to propose what tests should be blocking'. Covers ideas for AI-powered development workflows and testing infrastructure.
author: Hacker News Community

title: arXiv Paper: 'Agentic Code Reasoning' (2603.01896)
description: March 2026 arXiv paper investigates whether LLM agents can explore codebases and reason about code semantics without executing the code. Key finding: LLM agents can perform meaningful semantic code analysis without execution, potentially reducing verification overhead.
author: Researchers

title: Anthropic's 2026 AI Programming Trends Report
description: Anthropic releases comprehensive report on 8 major AI programming trends for 2026. Key finding: Teams using AI-assisted coding showed 8-12x faster delivery speeds compared to pure human teams. GitHub Copilot's enterprise user penetration reached significant milestones by March 2026.
author: Anthropic

title: State of AI in 2026: LLMs, Coding, Scaling Laws, China, Agents, GPUs, AGI
description: Lex Fridman Podcast #490 provides comprehensive overview of AI in 2026, covering technical breakthroughs, scaling laws, LLMs, coding developments, and the future of AGI. Features discussion on AI compute clusters and the future of human civilization.
author: Lex Fridman

title: IDC FutureScape 2026: When Intelligent Agents Enter Development Workflows
description: IDC predicts that agentic AI will deeply embed throughout the entire lifecycle from development, testing to operations and security in 2026. DevOps will be forced to evolve from 'toolchain upgrades' to 'operational model reconstruction'.
author: IDC Analysts
